title: Note67: ExoChain meeting receipts
description:
Add ExoChain meeting receipts to Note67 (CyberFitz-LLC/note67 fork).

## Scope

PRD: docs/exochain/PRD-meeting-receipts.md on branch feat/input-device-selection.
Supporting: docs/exochain/SCOPING.md, docs/exochain/note67-avc-draft.json.

Two receipt kinds:
- Meeting attestation (tool note67.meeting.attest) over transcript hash, consent assertion, and counts. Hashes only, never content.
- LYNK LLM usage receipt (exo.avc.lynk.llm_usage.evidence.v1, custody_mode ReceiptMinimized) for every remote model call.

## Explicitly out of scope

- Gating recording or local transcription. Recording must work with the node down, the credential expired, and enrollment skipped.
- R8 / DAG-DB governed state. Notes stay in local SQLite.
- Public-fleet credential provisioning.
- Any admissibility claim while exochain #696-700 is open.

This is a PLANNING entry. Do not begin implementation: P0 is blocked on three unanswered questions (below). Decompose or refine only.

## Blocked by

- exochained-toolkit#2 - sanctioned emit path for a native-Rust subject (blocks P0)
- exochained-toolkit#3 - subject_kind for a desktop app, per-install identity (blocks P0)
- exochained-toolkit#4 - endpoint to counterparty DID mapping (blocks P3, the enforcement phase)
- exochained-toolkit phases P2-P3 - hermetic node and live conformance harness are unbuilt, so nothing can be certified green

## Phases

- P0 identity + credential + enrollment UI (blocked)
- P1 meeting attestation + consent capture + Pending/Attested states + frozen transcript serialization
- P2 LYNK usage receipts on remote AI calls
- P3 endpoint enforcement via counterparties (blocked)
- P4 verification UI + provenance export
- P5 conformance suite + CI gate (blocked)

## Decisions already taken

- Consent is attested as an OPERATOR ASSERTION, never as verified consent. NotAsserted is a first-class outcome and does not block recording.
- data_class is PersonalData, not Confidential: a transcript is identifiable speech by named participants.
- Receipts claim existence, integrity and authorship only. Not recording time, not accuracy, not who spoke, not consent-in-fact.

## Highest risk

The canonical transcript serialization. If it drifts, every previously minted receipt stops verifying. Must be versioned and frozen before P1 ships.
